# Pinterest Tag

Apply the [media contract](../../media/common.md) and its linked implementation owners.

## Select the Pinterest route

Establish business/account use, Tag ID, business action, conversion/audience purpose, source event,
catalog convention and environment. Inspect partner-created GTM objects and current guidance at
https://help.pinterest.com/en/business/article/google-tag-manager-and-pinterest-tag plus linked
references. Inspect exact installed base/event fields, sequencing and automatic behavior.

Reuse compatible base ownership and select a current official event or supported custom path.
Reconcile base-before-event timing, page-visit behavior, partner objects and site code under the
[execution capability](../../web/execution.md). Map product audiences/ecommerce to the actual catalog
and current single/multi-item schema. Selected matching, event IDs, custom and privacy fields each
carry approved source/format/consent evidence.

[Capability classification](../../consent/product-capabilities.md) distinguishes Pinterest native
stop/hold from other consent routes. Apply the selected approved policy.

## Verify

Review Tag ID, event, complete item shape, matching/privacy fields and initialization/sequencing.
Account conversions, catalog/feed work and platform Test Events remain external dependencies.

## Server route

For Pinterest Conversions API, load [Server](server.md). Establish token custody, required `event_id`,
source, user-data hashing, contents projection and Tag+CAPI overlap.
